en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a group of African men working with a grain-winnowing machine outdoors. Sacks and baskets of grain are piled in the foreground, while a large colonial-style building with a veranda stands in the background. The scene appears rural and agricultural. Printed caption text and a small publisher credit appear at the bottom of the image.
